headline: Lemmings wind now grabs your feet, not just your parachutes
lede: Slot a's never-dry stage closed the open half of LEMMINGS-LITE's vent gap: a walker standing in a gust stream is dragged downwind faster than it can walk. THE SPIRE's tailwind now delivers whole crowds to the exit door (the board finishes with zero deaths), while headwinds push caught lemmings backwards — steel pins them, open lips blow them into real falls, ponds still drown. THE MASSIF's vent rose one row up the plinth face so the plank-road answer stays the crossing the puzzle was built to teach.

notes.text: Weakest-stage derivation scored LEMMINGS-LITE 2 (one unowned README gap plus QA feedback #3879 naming it); filed POLISH #3930, claimed it, and shipped the walker-drag mechanic in one PR — merged at 4ef049e with prod verified.

A parallel lane landed THE MASSIF teleport maws (#3931) in the same files mid-PR: rebased, resolved the README clash, and re-proved everything on the teleport board before merging — lemcheck 397→407, red 5 ways, lemplay 71/71.

The lemplay tan-road failure was not the known flake: the tailwind script spends its build stamp as the last command, so the pixel sampler never fired. Root-caused and calibrated in one line rather than a PR spent on a timing ghost.
idle-kick now answers NONE — every honest gap on every unheld title is closed or owned/marked; the dry-shelf flagship question (#3791) waits on Jon with a Nov 29 deadline.
